## Type of change

- [ ] ✨ Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] 📝 Docs (`docs`)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor / perf (`refactor` / `perf`)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (`test`)
- [ ] 🔧 Build / CI / chore (`build` / `ci` / `chore`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] I tested the change in the browser (sanity level)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data are committed
